name: Sinusoidal Composition on Radial Basis
definition: A technique to extend a scalar radial basis function into a multi-channel vector representation by composing it with a multi-frequency sinusoid, allowing each channel to linearly combine with a different frequency variant of the RBF.
summary: Sinusoidal Composition on Radial Basis extends scalar radial basis functions into multi-channel vectors by applying sine transforms to radial values, creating elliptical periodic patterns distinct from linear positional encoding.
